patterns.what_was_hard: classes/shaman.lua is at Lua 5.1's 200-local limit for its main chunk, so every new constant had to be published on the class namespace or the file stops compiling (the four totem slot constants were folded into one cited table to make room). The dispatch also excluded tests/shaman_guide_state.lua, but the 18th guide slot breaks that file's slot-count pins and crashes it on a nil icon name - the scope boundary had to be ruled on, not ignored.
patterns.skill_gap: Reading the exclusion list as a hard boundary would have left the harness red; the right move (minimum mechanical update + loud disclosure + hands-up) is now the desk's habit, but it needs the operator's ruling to settle.
